name: a5g5-evidence-rows
description: Identity sentinel for the GLUE-5 evidence rows. Two jobs: (1) the client-modules loader maps plugin rows to the NEAREST package.json — without this file both observer/stray rows resolve to the repo-root dsh-agent-team client package and boot refuses ('resolves from multiple active Loader sources'); (2) the plugin-package-inventory-deepseek REQUEST EXTENSION reads that nearest package.json for EVERY model request and throws REQUEST_EXTENSION unless name AND version are non-empty strings (world-measured the hard way: a version-less sentinel here silently killed every turn in the world). No dsh.client here: zero client surface.
